nodes.label: Land Use Transition Matrix Schema
nodes.rationale: Defines the expected schema for the land-use transition CSV so in-page crosswalk defaults can be overridden by data and the same pipeline can later be fed by a SQL table or ETL output.

nodes.label: land-use-transition-matrix.csv
nodes.rationale: Data file under public/data/ carrying source_item, target_item, weight, rationale, source_system, target_system, valid_from_year, valid_to_year and notes columns; kept as CSV so rules are editable without a code change.

nodes.label: land_use_transition_matrix (SQL table)
nodes.rationale: Proposed relational form of the CSV, adding id, is_active, created_at and updated_at so rules can be soft-disabled and audited rather than deleted.

nodes.label: idx_land_use_transition_matrix_source
nodes.rationale: Composite index on (source_item, is_active) because lookups always fan out from one source class over active rules only.

nodes.label: Transition Rule (source_item to target_item with weight)
nodes.rationale: A rule states that a losing land class flows into a gaining land class with a relative weight scoped to the same source_item, plus validity years so historical reclassifications can coexist with current ones.
nodes.norm_label: transition rule (source_item to target_item with weight)

nodes.label: LAND_USE_CROSSWALK_RULES (inline defaults)
nodes.rationale: In-code default crosswalk rules kept as the fallback so the page still renders when the CSV is missing or malformed.

nodes.label: Crosswalk Resolution Pipeline (CSV-first with inline fallback)
nodes.rationale: Try the CSV first; use it only if it parses into valid rows; otherwise fall back to inline defaults. Designed so the same seam can later be pointed at an API or SQL query instead of a file.
nodes.norm_label: crosswalk resolution pipeline (csv-first with inline fallback)

nodes.label: Sankey Transition Signal
nodes.rationale: Produced from explicit source-to-target transition rules rather than inferred flows, so the diagram's links are auditable.

nodes.label: React Logo Mark (react.svg)
nodes.rationale: Vite/React scaffold branding asset: the React atom mark in #00D8FF on a 256x228 viewBox, aria-hidden and marked role=img so it is decorative only.
